gaps: The available library case covers resetting smart lots on a published active RFQ but expects success, not rejection after a lot has already been published.
No setup recipe expresses that a lot has already been published or that the sandbox has no twin.
The request's unchanged plan state cannot be verified with the available read-back fields.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

steps: The buyer sends the event groups reset to smart lots request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
